name: CSUMB Lopez Point original 1 m Reson and SWATHplus acoustic backscatter mosaics

producer.name: California State University Monterey Bay Seafloor Mapping Lab; archived by NOAA NCEI

units.acoustic_backscatter_intensity: display/intensity values; no calibrated rock class

spatial.horizontal_crs: EPSG:26910; producer backscatter processing states NAD83(CORS96)
spatial.note: The Reson mosaic shares the bathymetric sonar; the 468 kHz SWATHplus mosaic uses a separate acoustic system in the same survey. Neither image is a bottom-type classification.

temporal.update_cadence: Static survey; monthly hash and metadata recheck

provenance.access_service: NOAA NCEI original Big Creek processed-product archive
transformations: Opened original nested LopezPt 1 m sidescan ZIP and both TIFF/FGDC metadata pairs; no imagery was redistributed.
Verified native raster CRS, resolution, dimensions, source bytes and producer statements about processing frame and use terms.
See dist/data/lopez-original-backscatter-source-review.json for product and metadata hashes, scope and release holds.

evidence.supports: Original nested product includes 1 m Reson 7125 and SEA SWATHplus backscatter TIFFs and source metadata.
Producer's general public-use and for-profit restrictions require review; product metadata specifically leave access/use constraints to be determined.

limitations: Acoustic amplitude cannot be treated as rock, boulder size, fish presence, catch probability or a verified fishing coordinate without radiometric calibration and independent bottom observations.
The producer's CORS96 processing statement applies to backscatter mosaics; it does not prove that the paired final bathymetry raster has the same horizontal realization or epoch.
Both TIFFs expose all-valid masks and no declared nodata; internal display/background pixels mean source coverage must be resolved before a cellwise comparison.
Public reuse or for-profit redistribution of the images is not cleared. No ranked fishing target or chartplotter export follows from this source.
